name: Minor Glamour
description: Changes color, voice, scent, or superficial appearance of a person or object.

name: Phantom Sound
description: Creates misleading noises of movement, speech, impact, or nearby activity.

name: Blur Edge
description: Softens the outline of a creature or object so aim, attention, and tracking slide off.

name: Minor Figment
description: Produces a small harmless image, shadow, light, or false occupancy cue.

name: Veil of Plainness
description: Makes a target seem ordinary, forgettable, harmless, or contextually expected.

name: Mirror Self
description: Produces one or more moving decoys that mimic the caster closely enough to split attention and draw attacks.

name: Hallway Trick
description: Distorts depth, direction, doors, and scale in a corridor, path, or room to confuse pursuit.

name: Borrowed Face
description: Overlays the caster with a convincing disguise of age, expression, stature, and identity.

name: Veilmind
description: Clouds attention and witness certainty, making targets doubt what they saw, heard, or meant to do.

name: Compelling Image
description: Creates a stable multisensory illusion convincing enough to guide movement, emotion, and tactical choices.

name: Nightmare Phantasm
description: Weaponizes fear, desire, or expectation into targeted illusion that induces hesitation, panic, or misjudgment.

name: False Memory Stitch
description: Plants or edits a narrow memory impression such as a brief meeting, a face glimpsed, or a door believed locked.

name: Mirage Dominion
description: Recasts the visible logic of a district, camp, hall, or battlefield so that routes, identities, and events seem to follow a false pattern.

name: Dream Theater
description: Overwrites a broad scene with a coherent sensory reality strong enough to change behavior.

name: Sovereign Glamour
description: The supreme illusion: for a scene or site, the caster authors the dominant perceived reality, forcing navigation, trust, targeting, and fear to obey its logic unless actively broken.
